title: Modular Exponentiation
prompt:
Compute the least non-negative residue:

    10^131 mod 7
hint: reduce the exponent with Fermat's little theorem; enter one integer
recap: Modular exponentiation a^b mod m is computed by repeated squaring. Fermat's little theorem helps: if m is prime and gcd(a, m) = 1 then a^(m-1) ≡ 1, so reduce the exponent mod (m − 1) first.
